findings.summary: policy_scan matches only the exact strings without separators: "位级·等价" (middle dot) is NOT detected. The A-2 addenda writes the withdrawn originals as "位级·等价" and reports 0 hits, attributing it to negation exemption; in fact it is the separator that bypasses the pattern. The same gap exists for "位级 等价"/"位级-等价"/"位级_等价". Receipt forbidden_phrases list (with dots) also disagrees with the code (no dots).
findings.suggest: normalize separators before matching (strip · space - _ or use regex like 位级[\s·\-_]?等价); correct the addenda attribution; align receipt forbidden list with code

negation window is 18 chars before the phrase; distant negators cause false positives and nearby negators can over-exempt; record the limitation
